verdict.rationale: Extend documents a headless path: a CLI with scriptable output and batch commands, API-key Bearer authentication, official SDKs, and isolated test-mode keys suited to automated runs. However, nothing explicitly documents running in CI pipelines, so the CI half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration documentation (e.g. a CI pipeline guide or example), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Commands: parse · extract · classify · split · edit · detect-form · workflows run · batch · Output and scripting
The Extend API authenticates every request with a Bearer token. Create an API key from your Developer settings
Use a test-mode API key to run extractions, classifications, and workflows against an isolated test environment with no production data or webhooks.
Equip an agent that runs the CLI
